source: create a music performance where there is a 3d rendered punk rock star on stage with a screen in the back ground. The rockstar is generating music energy rendered in a sound wave in a gui on top of screen. the player is creating a show earning VFX, back ground display, lasers, and fireworks. below are the different show effects the player can equip and tap to create the show

image_prompt.text: The stage as the hero build - a punk rock star standing centre stage, composed to be the thing every vantage frames
The viewer placed square on to the stage so the first thing seen is the performer against the lit screen, never the rigging behind it
A large screen spanning the back of the stage, running the show's background display
Laser rigs mounted around and above the stage, angled out over the performance space
Firework and pyro emitters positioned along the front and sides of the stage

layout_placement.text: Spawn placed and oriented facing the stage so the performer is the first thing a joining player sees
Small optional finds tucked around the edges of the venue
Trigger points around the stage that the equipped show effects - lasers, pyro, background visuals - fire from when the player taps them

notes: Close call on genre: this is a stage show the player produces, not an environment to walk through. Entertainment was the nearest fit and its free-roam shape was taken because the guided-route shape would impose a walking sequence the prompt does not have.
Preset caveat: the hidden-badge collectible carried by this preset fights a single-stage venue - see preset_rejected.

open_questions.ask: Is this just the stage and its immediate frontage, or a whole venue with a crowd floor and back-of-house?
Does the player walk around the venue, or is the camera locked on the stage while they run the show?

theme: Punk rock concert - dark venue, stage lighting, neon and haze

coverage_missing.ask: Is there an audience space in front of the stage that players stand in, or is the stage the whole map?
Small club stage or arena scale?
Is the show scored or rated in some way, or is it purely expressive?

answers.ask: Is this just the stage and its immediate frontage, or a whole venue with a crowd floor and back-of-house?
answers.answer: Keep it to the stage and its immediate frontage; the focus is the punk rock star, background screen, and show effects rather than a full venue.

answers.ask: Does the player walk around the venue, or is the camera locked on the stage while they run the show?
answers.answer: Use a camera locked on the stage while the player runs the show through the GUI effects controls.
